samples.rationale: The match rule lives on the aggregate (Vet.hasSpecialty), so both surfaces share one definition and no business rule lands in the controller; the in-memory paging (findPaginated's subList/PageImpl block) is orchestration debt the ADR names and accepts. Tests are BDD-named and the predicate is unit-tested in VetTests, but three-tier data naming is ignored: bare "radiology", "   ", setId(100 + i), setId(1) are mystery values, and theFilteredBrowserPaginationShouldKeepTheSpecialtyAcrossPages asserts model attributes twice rather than that the rendered pagination links carry specialty — the behavior its name and REQ-VET-003 claim. Docs are thorough (NG-9 narrowing, REQ-VET-003, superseded note, open question, two ADRs), but system-design's Vets row still implements "—" though /vets is now a supported surface.
